text:
You can now pull the whole team out of Atlas as a CSV file. It lands on the Team plan on October 22. That plan is $19 per seat a month. A single export can hold 50,000 rows. The API limits you already have won't change. You get the same export limits whether you are on a free or paid account.

The file comes out in a form that most of the common spreadsheet tools will take. You can point it at a particular date range or leave it to cover the whole project. If the data you want is larger than 50,000 rows you will have to break the pull into a couple of pieces. None of that affects the rate limits that already apply to the API.
